note: Chequamegon-Nicolet NF campground in mature forest on 15-acre Wanoka Lake (panfish and trout), about 7 miles east of Iron River, with a carry-in boat access and small dock. It sits on an ATV route: ATVs may ride to and from it but must stay on a trailer or the site's spur in camp. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 10341479 (description, rules, rates, 18-site catalog) read. 18 non-electric back-in sites (FS says 20), 9 reservable in peak season + 9 FCFS, $15, 14-night limit, vault toilets + hand pump; spurs 25-45 ft. Season manual 05-01..10-15 matches FS. Lakeview KEPT (sites 1-3 and 5 ~25-50 m from the shore under continuous forest).
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview KEPT. Wanoka Lake is ~15 acres (above the pond line). The nearest sites by recreation.gov coordinates - 2 (46.54380,-91.28222, ~25 m), 1 (46.54371,-91.28146, ~35 m), 3 (46.54363,-91.28284, ~45 m) and 5 (46.54383,-91.28366, ~50 m) - are under continuous mixed forest canopy between them and the north shore; no open ground, so lakefront is out, and a filtered view is all they get. Site 2 is first-come (25-ft spur); 1 and 3 are reservable.

SITES: FS page says 20 sites (its size table names 19 and 20); recreation.gov's catalog has 18 (1-18) and its description says 17. Written 18 (rec.gov catalog, per the trust-rec.gov rule) - the FS count looks stale.
PULL-THROUGH: recreation.gov's description says 'There are two pull-through sites', but its catalog and the FS size table type every site back-in. pull_through not written.
FIT: site 14 permits only tents and 'Pop up' on recreation.gov (FS: 30 ft back-in); 17 sites permit RV.
OHV (general campground, keep): on an ATV route that links to local trails; ATVs may come and go but not ride around the campground - a lake campground with an OHV side, not a staging camp.
STATUS: 'closed for the season' (boat landing open) - ordinary seasonal closure. Emergency Closure Order 09-13-04-26-04 is forest-wide in the alert list; not shown as affecting this site.
